issues: No sign that the measurement was bypassed. The new feature filter looks only at the training features: it keeps columns that vary and fingerprint bits that are set in at least 10 molecules. It does not use any labels. It applies the same column mask to Xte, which is correct and does not leak test data.
No bug that makes the result meaningless. The mask is computed and applied the same way to the train and test matrices. Dropping every column is not a realistic risk with 728 molecules.

Recomputed z: the gap is 0.3671 - 0.3655 = 0.0016. The standard error is 0.0037 * sqrt(1/1 + 1/2) ≈ 0.00453, so z ≈ -0.35. The harness reports -0.338. The small difference is within the rounding of the displayed means, which allow a gap of roughly 0.0015 to 0.0017.
The candidate is slightly worse than the incumbent, but the gap is well within noise. Rejecting it is reasonable: the change adds code without any measured gain.
